name: php-mcp-server-generator
description: Generate a production-ready PHP MCP server with official PHP SDK, tools, resources, prompts, and tests.
Ask for project name, description, transport (stdio/http/both), tools, whether to include resources/prompts, and PHP version (8.2+ required).

Use Composer metadata: "name": "your-org/{project-name}", "description": "{Server description}", "optimize-autoloader": true, "preferred-install": "dist", "sort-packages": true. Require PHP 8.2 or higher.

Use strict types (`declare(strict_types=1);`) in all files; PHP Attributes `#[McpTool]`, `#[McpResource]`, `#[McpPrompt]`, `#[Schema]`; PSR-12; specific exceptions with clear messages; PHPDoc on all methods; PHPUnit tests for all tools; always use PSR-16 cache for discovery in production.

Server: `require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';`; use `Mcp\Server`, `Mcp\Server\Transport\StdioTransport`, `Symfony\Component\Cache\Adapter\FilesystemAdapter`, `Symfony\Component\Cache\Psr16Cache`. Configure `new Psr16Cache(new FilesystemAdapter('mcp-discovery', 3600, __DIR__ . '/cache'))`; builder `setServerInfo('{Project Name}', '1.0.0')`; discovery excludes `vendor`, `tests`, `cache`; run with `new StdioTransport()`.

Include example greeting `Hello, {$name}!`; arithmetic add/subtract/multiply/divide, throwing `Division by zero` and `Invalid operation`; config resource `config://app/setting
